home.title: Hand Germ Scanner
home.subtitle:
Point the camera at your hand
to find germs you can't see!
home.disclaimer: Not real germs — these are simulated images for learning

settings.title: Settings
settings.microscopeDescription: Shows realistic germ photos. Zoom in up to 10x.
settings.characterDescription: Shows cute cartoon germs. Zoom in up to 4x.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Here's how Hand Germ Scanner works

capture.title: Take a photo of your hand
capture.description: Tap "Get Started", fit your palm inside the frame, then tap the round shutter button.

washMode.title: Switch Before / After washing
washMode.description: Tap the small round button at the bottom right of the camera screen to switch between Before washing (pink 🧼) and After washing (white ✨).

zoom.title: Zoom in for a closer look
zoom.description: On the result screen, pinch with two fingers to zoom in — germs that were too small to see become big and clear.

retake.title: Retake the photo
retake.description: Tap "Retake" at the top left of the result screen to take a new photo from the start.

germMode.title: Change the germ display style
germMode.description: In "Settings" on the main screen, choose between realistic Microscope Mode and cute Character Mode.

camera.permissionMessage: Camera access is needed to scan for hand germs.
camera.guideText: Fit your palm inside the guide
camera.handNotDetectedMessage:
Please retake the photo with your
palm centered and filling the frame!

result.praise: ✨ Great job! Your germs are all gone!
